The '''Ucret system''' was a part of [[the Negs]] portion of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA" /> It shared its name with the individual known as [[Lanius of Ucret]].<ref name="Tinker">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/praji/20090205.html|text=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji|int=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Ucret [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square K-10.<ref name="TEA" />
